spanish: Y oyó Dios su gemido, y recordó Dios su pacto con Abraham, con Isaac y con Jacob.

adjudication.decision: Preserve the Hebrew verb-subject order in both coordinated clauses, repeat «Dios» where the source repeats it, and translate זכר directly as «recordó» without supplying a resulting action.
adjudication.scope: verse wording; not STATUS.md done approval
